ABS_REL_LPF_1: THE CENTRAL DESIGN DECISION. HEUR-DS-1 is an ABSOLUTE claim against a theoretical reference, not a relative claim against a second sample. LIMB B reads R(u) = p_hat(u)/rho(u) against the frozen constant-factor band with rho THEORETICAL and never replaced by a sample. LIMB A reads each certifying statistic against a MEASURED uniform-integer band at the same n and X. THE MATCHED-BITLENGTH UNIFORM ARM IS A CALIBRATION OF THE APPARATUS AND IS NOT THE COMPARISON - its first duty is to measure how far a KNOWN-UNIFORM sample of this exact size at this exact X departs from asymptotic Dickman, separating the finite-X error of the reference from any Semaev-specific departure. IF THE UNIFORM ARM ITSELF LEAVES THE BAND AT A RUNG, LIMB B IS NOT DECIDABLE AT THAT RUNG, reported as a statement about the apparatus and the reference and never as a result about the Semaev map in either direction. No branch may be satisfied by a two-sample agreement alone; STAT-KS2-CAL is declared NON-CERTIFYING for both limbs. This closes the hole ALT-CLASS-DEP-1's U1 exposed - a two-sample design is blind BY CONSTRUCTION to any deviation both arms share, and a finite-X departure from an asymptotic reference is exactly such a deviation. Conflating the calibration with the comparison is what made BATCH-023's result bound half of what it appeared to.

TAIL_LPF_1_repairs_BATCH_022_at_the_root: BATCH-022's TAIL-DS-1 used the sample MAXIMUM, and with p_ext = min_j rho(u_j) the quantity n*p_ext is asymptotically Exp(1), giving P(pass) = 1/e = 0.3679 ON A PERFECTLY CORRECT UNIFORM SAMPLE - and at the toy X asymptotic rho under-predicts deep-tail smoothness, pushing it lower still, in exactly the direction that would be misread as a Semaev finding. TAIL-LPF-1 uses the TENTH-LARGEST order statistic against a TWO-SIDED MEASURED band of 200 uniform replicates at the same n and X, with the exact per-comparison false-fire probability 4/201 = 0.0199 stated PRE-DATUM, and requires attainability demonstrated with measured numbers in BOTH directions before the rule freezes. THE GENERALIZATION: the reference is theoretical and enters through the STATISTIC, making the comparison absolute; the threshold is MEASURED and never analytic, making the test attainable at finite X.

BATCH-024's CTRL-DEP-MONO went unevaluated and that is exactly where its failure hid - two of three plant families could not create the deviation they certified against, and a two-endpoint check could not see it.
preregistration_binding: ATS-LPF-1 clause 1 dates the freeze to THIS COMMIT, not to authoring. The threshold RULE and the branch structure are bound here, before any datum exists, so the calibration supplies a NUMBER and never a CHOICE. No threshold number appears anywhere in the contract - including in the metrics block - because under THR-LPF-1 and TAIL-LPF-1 the bands are MEASURED and do not exist until the calibration completes; writing one now would be either a fabrication or an analytic threshold, and both are forbidden.
success_criterion_is_completeness_not_di: SUCC-LPF-1. Success is a complete, valid, independently reviewed measurement that the frozen rule classifies into exactly one branch, WHICHEVER BRANCH THAT IS. LIMB B non-decidability at a rung is a SATISFIED criterion and not a failure - it is a measured fact about the asymptotic reference at finite X, precisely what the uniform calibration arm exists to supply. What the run may not do is quietly read an undecidable rung as consistent OR as a departure.
what_this_batch_finally_does: PAYS OPEN-BATCH023-A. EXP-LPF-001 samples genuine half-arity Semaev partial-map intermediates, FACTORS THEM, records the largest prime factor and B-smoothness of each, and reads the empirical distribution against Dickman rho(u). NO EXPERIMENT IN TWENTY-FIVE BATCHES HAS FACTORED A SINGLE INTEGER, while HEUR-DS-1 - on which every exponent claim in this campaign rests - is a claim about B-smoothness. BATCH-022 tried and failed review; BATCH-023 measured an INPUT to it; BATCH-024 measured an INSTRUMENT for that input.
